header: One image, one numbered legend beside it
lead: Each entry names a marked place in the picture and explains it in a sentence. The numbers follow the child order, so reordering the entries renumbers both the list and what it refers to.
caption: The picture takes the wider of the two columns.

callouts.title: The markers live in the artwork
callouts.text: Drawing them over a responsive image would mean guessing coordinates that were true at one width only.

callouts.title: The legend is an ordered list
callouts.text: So the sequence survives for a reader who never sees the discs.

callouts.title: Reverse swaps the columns
callouts.text: Source order stays the same; only the layout changes sides.

callouts.title: The picture gets the wider column
callouts.text: Three parts to two, because the numbers inside it have to stay readable.
